title: UC10 loan 10 period-3 schedule interest (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing ONE period's interest of UC10 loan 10 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanRepaymentSchedule.feature (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits; product LP2_ADV_PYMNT_INTEREST_DECL_BAL_SARP_EMI_360_30_INT_RECALC_DAILY_MULTIDISB_PARTIAL_PERIOD). request.schedule transcribes the outstanding principal the period accrues on, periods[2].principalLoanBalanceOutstanding 434.77 -> "43477" minor units, annualInterestRate 12.0 -> 12, and the terms' declared day basis daysInYearType.id 360 / daysInMonthType.id 30. expect.interest_minor transcribes the period's observed interestDue 4.35 -> "435" minor units. The observed 4.35 is NOT a HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie (434.77*12*30/(100*360) = 435), so this vector corroborates the interest cell but does not discriminate the rounding mode (the pinned LN-L06 cell does). period 1 accrues on 1000.00 for only half a month before the 200.00 tranche dated 2025-02-15 and period 2 straddles that tranche, so their observed interestDue 4.52 and 11.29 are BLENDS and are REFUSED. Period 3 accrues on the constant 434.77 and is transcribed. Nothing was computed by this promotion.  UC10 is the scenario whose pinned build returns a period-2 split one minor unit off its own feature table (F-2026-09-11-tierd-repsched-mnt-uc10): the feature expects principal 429.74 / interest 11.28 / balance 434.76, the oracle read back 429.73 / 11.29 / 434.77; the oracle's output IS the observation. Period 1 (observed interestDue 4.52, obligationsMetOnDate 2025-01-15, complete true) is a PARTIAL-PERIOD accrual that does not equal the single-principal 360/30 formula on 1000.00 and is REFUSED; period 2 (observed 11.29) straddles the 200.00 tranche dated 2025-02-15 and is the disputed blend, also REFUSED; period 3 accrues on the constant 434.77 and its observed 4.35 equals the 360/30 formula, so it is transcribed. The UC10 loan-10 read-back was not among the PASSED read-backs; it was extracted from the MNT replay log with .softhouse/capture/tierd-feasibility/bin/extract.py and committed under loans/loan-10/loan-10-detail-associations-repaymentSchedule.json (sha256 c184624a...), with its manifest line set committed.
